statements.impact_statement: Applies only to this development service: all application mappings are explicitly enumerated JSON RestControllers; no wildcard view route, XsltView or XsltViewResolver is registered. FoundationTest.jsonOnlyRoutesKeepDevelopmentVexAssumptionsTrue enforces these assumptions. This is an applicability assessment, not a patched Spring artifact or production risk acceptance. Reassess before any controller/view change; a supported-framework migration is required before production. Primary advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47884/

Applies only to this development service: no SSE, streamed view fragments, streaming responses or server-rendered views are used. Application controller return types are restricted to the two JSON metadata records by FoundationTest.jsonOnlyRoutesKeepDevelopmentVexAssumptionsTrue. Reassess before adding routes or streaming. This does not claim the underlying library is fixed. Primary advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47890/
